desc: Our Safe Maker series represents the pinnacle of our learning, experience, testing, and development. The blades, shafts and "T" shaped tangs are fashioned from one solid piece of Japanese AUS8A Stainless Steel with a stone washed finish and then subsequently vacuum heat treated and sub-zero quenched for added strength and performance. A textured Kray-Ex handle encapsulates the tang and part of the shaft for added comfort and security. Includes an easily concealable and sturdy Secure-Ex boot/belt sheath.
